findings.reason: the unification the clause is meant to measure is satisfied by the unfixed code, so the node can land its reader change without the two ever having to agree on the only inputs where they disagree.
findings.text: §15 requires "for a lane that declares `[text, image]`, one that declares `[text]`, one with an empty declaration and one with none, `declares_image_input` and `declared_input_modalities` agree on whether the lane admits an image", but all four cases already agree at the reviewed revision and the two readers diverge on exactly the forms the list omits — measured `declared_input_modalities` sees `"text,image"`, `"IMAGE"` and `" image "` as no image while `declares_image_input` sees all three as an image, because `reckon/flight.py:1964` returns `tuple(str(m) for m in declared)` with no split, strip or case fold while `reckon/_backends.py:2153` splits on comma and lowercases

findings.reason: a worker implementing the section exactly as written produces a doubled listing and a red lane-change case, and the fix — strip an existing listing, make the helper idempotent, or write the lane-change file from the record's restated prompt rather than from plan.stdin_text — is a design the plan does not choose.
findings.text: §15's Change writes both the fresh and the lane-change prompt file "from the prompt `launch_plan` composed" (plan.stdin_text) and asserts "the composition lists each figure once rather than appending a second listing", but a lane change builds its input from the record's own prompt file (`_lane_prompt` reads `record["prompt_path"]`, `reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1598-1604`, when `continued=False`) which §15's fresh-dispatch half has just written with its figure listing, and `_prompt_naming_images` appends unconditionally (`reckon/_backends.py:2160`, applied at `:2304`, carried out as `stdin_text=prompt` at `:2349`) — so the composed text and a prompt file written from it name each path twice, and the done-when's "exactly once" cannot hold; no mechanism for avoiding the second listing is named

findings.reason: all three land in the same two files in one commit and the comment is one line, so splitting would add bookkeeping without changing what is built or how it is reviewed.
findings.text: the section also carries "the comment above `IMAGE_MODALITY` … names its one real reader" and "both read the declaration through one function in `reckon/flight.py`", two deliverables unrelated to its title or its "prompt file carries its named figures" measure
